implemented: C99Client.h/.cpp forwards opaque handles, live node/camera/scene properties, hierarchy, geometry, material and texture operations through public C99

Each material retains its own native identity; original uniform names and sampler names replace emitted offsets/slots

Header-only user-language values/containers/closures/JSON/GC support stays outside Core; no JavaScript VM
Core/public header and compiler checkout are not edited
remainingBoundaries: Repeated same-factory material instances are explicitly refused when emitted scene setters have lost original instance identity; this full game reaches one instance per factory
Options-variable MaterialIdentity.ts frontend refusal is retained; this is not general arbitrary-application projection
Native HUD is a scoped adaptation, not full CSS/DOM or RmlUI-equivalent rendering
Human interaction/hearing and cross-backend pixel equivalence are not established
Long-lived/general client lifetime and complete corpus/API semantics beyond executed tests are not claimed
